messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT ▶ autoscale-throttle spike on prod-east
IncidentBot: throttle_rate=8.3% sustained 6m, queue_depth median=420, tokens/sec anomalous. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inference/prod-east

sre_alex: I'm looking. Seeing queue latency at ~2.1s and a cluster of throttle events from the token-batcher. grabbing logs.

oncall_maya: Ack — paging oncall. Any customer-facing errors yet?

eng_jordan: We have elevated 502/504s for a small subset of tenants hitting large-context models. Correlates with long seq lengths + concurrent requests. Suggest immediate scale + temporary routing to smaller-quantized model variant.

sre_alex: Quick mitigation: scaling inference-pool-prod from 8 -> 20 replicas now.
```bash
kubectl scale deploy inference-pool-prod --replicas=20 -n prod
# started at 2245554321
```

monitoring_bot: Autoscaler override applied by sre_alex; desired replicas=20. New pods healthy in ~95s.

oncall_maya: Good. Jordan, can you flip routing to fallback variant for heavy-context routes until we stabilize?

eng_jordan: Doing a canary route change for /v1/generate that targets model-x-small for requests > 8k tokens. Applying now.

sre_alex: Throttle_rate dropping — down to 0.9% and queue_depth median -> 120 after scale + routing change.

pm_sam: CS: two enterprise customers reported degraded latencies (sent retrospective notes). No data loss but increased tail latency. Looping in support.

oncall_maya: Notes for post-incident: customer impact = increased latencies for subset of tenants, short-lived errors for < 10 minutes. No degradation of embeddings pipeline.

sre_alex: Proposed alert tuning (initial):
- queue_depth: raise threshold from 300 -> 450
- debounce: increase from 60s -> 180s for the high-noise queue metric
- add correlated alert: tokens/sec per-tenant > X and throttle_rate > 2% -> page
- add dashboard panel: throttle_ratio by tenant and model (1h/5m)

eng_jordan: Also recommend adding an autoscale policy that considers seq_length distribution (burst of long sequences should not immediately scale down normal pools). I'll draft config.

oncall_maya: Action items (owners):
- Alex: implement alert threshold + debounce change and update alert definitions (ETA 2h)
- Jordan: dashboard panels + autoscale policy PR (ETA EOD)
- Maya: write initial incident summary + schedule postmortem in #incidents (ETA tomorrow)
- Sam/CS: send impact note to affected customers (in progress)

sre_alex: Creating ticket INF-5812 for alert retune + runbook changes. Link: https://jira.redwood/INF-5812

monitoring_bot: Alert INF-queue-high suppressed (muted by 3m) while we tune. Will re-evaluate after change.

oncall_maya: Thanks team. We'll close this thread after postmortem + alert verification. If anything regresses, re-open.

IncidentBot: RESOLVED ▶ throttle_rate normalized. Incident window: 2245554321 - 2245554667
